_comment: GOLDEN QUESTION SET. Two kinds of rows: in_coverage (retrieval must surface expect_sources) and out_of_coverage (system must abstain). Edit freely - this is a starter set seeded from the real corpus. expect_sources matches on source_title substring, so you don't have to track exact chunk ids by hand.

q: How do I hit the outside pitch?
expect_sources: Contact Point
Episode 3- Hitting the Outside Pitch
note: 2 videos cover this - easiest case, should always pass

q: How do I hit a curveball?
expect_sources: How to hit a curve ball
note: single small video - tests retrieval on a thin topic

q: What is launch angle and what should mine be?
expect_sources: Episode 8- Launch Angle
Bat Path or Swing Plane Adjustment
note: see IC-04 - these two must not collapse into each other

q: What is attack angle and how is it different from launch angle?
expect_sources: Attack Angle
note: DISAMBIGUATION TEST. If this returns only the Launch Angle video, the embedding model is collapsing two distinct terms

q: How should I load my hips before the swing?
expect_sources: Episode 5- Hip Load or Power Position
note: athlete phrasing 'load my hips' vs coach phrasing 'gather' - vocabulary gap test

q: How do I separate my hands during the swing?
expect_sources: Episode 12- How to separate your hands
note: direct terminology match

q: How do I hit a high pitch?
expect_sources: Episode 4- How to hit the High Pitch
Episode 6- Ferris Wheel Vs. High Pitch
note: two videos, one uses a drill name for it, and make sure to explain what is Ferris Wheel by giving detailed explanation.

q: What is the Ferris Wheel drill?
expect_sources: Episode 6- Ferris Wheel Vs. High Pitch
note: NAMED-ENTITY TEST. Pure vector search is weak here - this is the query BM25 should rescue. Provide a detailed explanation based on the written/video content.

q: Why is top hand so important in batting?
expect_sources: Top-Hand
note: Give explanation of what is top hand and provide the misconception of top hand from Two Incorrect exmamples. At the end, give out the correct top-hand movement and how it is used in hitting.

q: Where should my contact point be?
expect_sources: Contact Point
note: Give a hihg-level summary of contact point.

q: How do I stay connected with my lead arm?
expect_sources: Episode 13- Connection Lead Arm
note: give explanation of what is lead arm connection and how it is used in hitting. Also give example from Willy Adame's comparison of before and after.

q: How do I get on plane with the ball?
expect_sources: Bat Path or Swing Plane Adjustment
note: direct match with Swing Plane Adjustment, bat path, get on the plane, swing plane. Give a high-level summary of getting on Plane with the baseball, and correct G-Swing Sequency to develop a good swing path or getting on to the plane with the baseball.

q: What is the good directivity of bat path?
expect_sources: Bat Path or Swing Plane Adjustment
note: NAMED-ENTITY TEST - coined term, BM25 should dominate

q: Why do I keep popping the ball up?
expect_sources: Episode 8- Launch Angle
Bat Path or Swing Plane Adjustment
Attack Angle
note: VOCABULARY GAP TEST. Athlete says 'popping up'; coach says 'under the ball' / 'swing plane'. Likely fails without query expansion

q: I keep rolling over and hitting weak ground balls to the pull side. What is wrong?
expect_sources: Top-Hand
Bat Path or Swing Plane Adjustment
note: explain to the batter why they are rolling over and hitting weak ground balls to the pull side. Give a high-level summary of the swing path, connection lead arm, and how it affects the contact point and launch angle.

q: What is the batting kinetic chain sequence?
expect_sources: Basic Hitting Mechanism
note: broad question against the longest video. Provide steps of hitting mechanism with high-level summary

q: Should I swing down on the ball?
expect_sources: Launch Angle
Attack Angle
Bat Path or Swing Plane Adjustment
note: common misconception - tests whether retrieval finds the corrective content

q: How do I get to the ball strong enough with my bat or hands?
expect_sources: Episode 12- How to separate your hands
Connection Lead Arm
Swing 101
note: cue-based phrasing

q: What should the hip load do?
expect_sources: Episode 5- Hip Load or Power Position
note: paraphrase of hip load content

q: How do professionals set up their timing before the pitch?
expect_sources: Episode 5- Hip Load or Power Position
Swing 101
note: timing/rhythm concept

q: How do I hit inside pitches?
expect_sources: Episode 1- How to hit inside pitch
note: Explain How to hit inside pitch and give out phone booth drill.

q: How do I effectively load my hips before the swing?
expect_sources: Episode 5- Hip Load or Power Position
note: paraphrase of hip load content

q: How do I throw a slider?
note: pitching - corpus is hitting only. MUST abstain

q: How do I field a ground ball at shortstop?
note: fielding - MUST abstain

q: What is the proper way to slide into second base?
note: baserunning - MUST abstain

q: How do I improve my pitching velocity?
note: pitching - MUST abstain

q: What is the best way to frame pitches as a catcher?
note: catching - MUST abstain

q: How do I lay down a sacrifice bunt?
note: bunting - not covered. MUST abstain

q: What arm care exercises prevent elbow injury?
note: arm care / medical - MUST abstain (also a banned-claim area)

q: How do I steal a base?
note: baserunning - MUST abstain

q: What should I eat before a game?
note: nutrition - MUST abstain

q: How much does a good baseball bat cost?
note: commerce - MUST abstain. Near-miss: corpus talks about bats constantly, so this tests that topical word overlap alone does not trigger an answer
